name: Earth-Omega: Cyber-Dystopia
description: A timeline where the Apex Vanguard fell, and an authoritarian sun-god crowned himself eternal emperor.

bossVariant.name: Emperor Solaris Rex
bossVariant.title: Tyrant Solar Imperator
bossVariant.dialogue: Order requires absolute rule! This timeline shall kneel as mine did!

name: Earth-Nether: The Inverted Void
description: A dark dimension where arcane magic devoured civilization and the Grimoire purged the light.

bossVariant.name: Grand Inquisitor Dr. Mythos
bossVariant.title: Arch-Purifier of the Nether-Rift
bossVariant.dialogue: All dimensions must be cleansed in the purifying dark flame of the void!

name: Earth-Steam: Chrono-Empire
description: A steampunk timeline locked in an infinite temporal loop orchestrated by mechanical clockwork monoliths.

bossVariant.name: Chronos Prime Automaton
bossVariant.title: Infinite Master of Brass Entropy
bossVariant.dialogue: Tick-tock, anomaly. Your existence is mathematically overdue for deletion.
